---
title: "`r MultiScholaR:::integrationRecordTexts()[['report_title']]`"
output: word_document
params:
  record_path: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# KIT-142: the integration report. Every value and every heading is read from the analysis record and the wording
# table (`integrationRecordTexts()`); nothing is described that the record does not carry.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
record <- jsonlite::read_json(params$record_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
texts <- MultiScholaR:::integrationRecordTexts()
tables <- MultiScholaR:::integrationRecordTables(record, texts)
show <- function(table) if (is.data.frame(table) && nrow(table)) knitr::kable(table, row.names = FALSE) else cat(texts[["none_recorded"]], "\n")
heading <- function(key) cat("\n\n# ", texts[[key]], "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r intro, results = "asis"}
cat(texts[["report_intro"]], "\n")
heading("section_methods")
cat("*", texts[["methods_draft_note"]], "*\n\n", sep = "")
cat(MultiScholaR:::integrationMethodsText(record, texts), "\n")
```

```{r inputs, results = "asis"}
heading("section_inputs")
show(tables$integration_inputs)
```

```{r matching, results = "asis"}
heading("section_matching")
show(tables$integration_matching)
```

```{r settings, results = "asis"}
heading("section_settings")
show(tables$integration_settings)
cat("\n\n## ", texts[["section_legend"]], "\n\n", sep = "")
legend <- data.frame(unname(texts[c("status_decided", "status_provisional_default", "status_user_set", "status_input")]),
    unname(texts[c("legend_decided", "legend_provisional_default", "legend_user_set", "legend_input")]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(legend) <- unname(texts[c("col_status", "col_status_meaning")])
show(legend)
```

```{r model, results = "asis"}
heading("section_model")
show(tables$integration_model)
heading("section_variance")
show(tables$integration_variance)
```

```{r claim, results = "asis"}
heading("section_notes")
show(tables$integration_notes)
```

```{r results, results = "asis"}
heading("section_results")
show(tables$integration_results)
```

```{r samples, results = "asis"}
heading("section_samples")
show(tables$integration_samples)
```
